shortcut: CI test failure cascade from infrastructure dependency
detail: When CI integration tests depend on external services (databases, message queues, APIs) running in containers, a single infrastructure component failure cascades across all test suites. A postgresql container that fails to start within the timeout causes all database-dependent tests to fail, which then blocks all deployment pipelines. The error is amplified in kubernetes-based CI runners where container scheduling delays are common. Prerequisite: understanding CI infrastructure resilience and test isolation. Requires health checks and retry logic for CI service containers. To mitigate: add readiness health checks before running tests, use service containers with retry wrappers. Fix: implement wait-for-it scripts for CI service dependencies, use in-memory alternatives for non-critical tests, and parallelize independent test suites.
